_comment: The ground texture array, in the order the shader and the renderer keep it (assets/terrain/ph/<name>/ph_<name>_*.png, packed by tools/pack_terrain.py). The first sixteen are the engine's own ground - the default category draws with them and nothing else - and must stay where they are. metres: ground one turn of the texture covers (the scan's physical size, from its packed.json). A soil or a rock names a layer by its name here. Changing this list changes the shader's constants (terrain_layers.gen.hlsli): one recompile.

layers.name: leafy_grass
layers.role: grass: meadow ground under the grass cards

layers.name: moon_dusted_04
layers.role: wastes: grey dead powder (scan 0.56 m, laid at twice its size)

layers.name: rubble
layers.role: wastes: grey grit and broken stone

layers.name: brown_mud_leaves_01
layers.role: bog: mossy mud under the swamp forest

layers.name: burned_ground_01
layers.role: blight: craters dark with the black wind's power, charred ground

layers.name: red_laterite_soil_stones
layers.role: laterite: red savanna and tropical soil
